reason: Joining is free, but I would have to dig out my ID and commercial registration, upload them and wait for someone to approve me before I could even send a quote. I am busy with real jobs, so I would not start that process in a normal week.
objection: Uploading documents and waiting for approval is a hassle, and I do not know yet if the requests here are real and nearby enough to be worth the trouble.
would_change_my_mind: If approval were quick and I could see a few real nearby requests with the money held safely before I had to upload anything.
